sourceReview.reviewThrough: Tracker version33 through T1-90 reviewed before T1-91. All29 deliverables synchronized to the current workbook before marking P1-26 customer management functionality Complete. Business acceptance and physical/live UAT remain separate and unchanged.

definitions.Complete: Full original functionality delivered, separately from acceptance.
definitions.Partial: Usable subset exists and remaining functionality is identified.
definitions.Pending: Requested business journey is not delivered; foundations may exist.

deliverables.name: Registration
deliverables.existing: Organization onboarding and imported-customer ownership exist. T1-43 verifies existing customers only. T1-53 adds published, versioned account-agreement review/capture for existing owned customers. T1-54 adds opt-in guided setup and server financial-workspace admission derived from verified email, reviewed profile and current agreement acceptance.
deliverables.remaining: Complete public customer registration/activation and create the owned customer identity. Prove integrated email/database setup and supply approved legal content; T1-54 covers existing customer setup at the LOCAL product ingress only.

deliverables.name: Login
deliverables.existing: Existing imported customers can enter with an email verification code. Session activity and selected session termination are implemented.
deliverables.remaining: Complete the agreed customer authentication policy and activation coverage. Prove actual SMTP delivery and PostgreSQL session issuance/revocation.

deliverables.name: Profile
deliverables.existing: My Profile reads the registered email and edits display name and an optional unverified contact number, with versioned owner writes. T1-55 adds optional self-declared date of birth, exact calendar-date validation and owner receipt/readback. T1-56 adds optional self-declared PAN with authenticated encryption, masked owner readback, explicit replacement/removal and C&I audit metadata.
deliverables.remaining: Complete authoritative KYC status and remaining profile/Settings requirements under approved privacy rules. Self-declared PAN is not identity/KYC verification. Prove physical PostgreSQL persistence/replay/concurrency/grants and integrated UAT; production key custody/transport remain separate.

deliverables.name: Basic KYC
deliverables.existing: Customer identity and a RecordKycResult service-contract foundation exist. There is no completed customer KYC journey.
deliverables.remaining: Deliver the approved basic KYC evidence, status, review and customer experience. Enable any regulated route only under its existing approval.

deliverables.name: Upload
deliverables.existing: Customer-scoped original-byte upload, checksum/version identity, CSV intake and malware-check gate are implemented. T1-57 adds single-sheet financial-template XLSX original-byte intake through the same scan/hash/owner gates.
deliverables.remaining: Complete remaining required file-type/layout coverage, including legacy/arbitrary Excel only under an explicit scope. Verify live Docker/ClamAV benign and EICAR intake and durable original-byte storage.

deliverables.name: Document vault
deliverables.existing: Authorized library, document details, exact source links, processing activity and version history are implemented.
deliverables.remaining: Complete the specified document category taxonomy, metadata, storage/verification presentation and replacement/reindex journey.

deliverables.name: Classification
deliverables.existing: Strict recognition covers eight printed-English OCR classes, now including vehicle purchase invoices, in supported PNG/JPEG/single-page PDFs. Mixed known titles reject. Broader classes/layouts remain open.
deliverables.remaining: Cover the remaining §11 document classes and layouts, persist classification/unknown-review state, and expose the administration workflow.

deliverables.name: OCR
deliverables.existing: Real pinned OCR reads eight printed-English document classes. T1-63 adds explicit vehicle purchase value, currency and invoice date in PNG/JPEG/single-page PDF. Original source and review remain required.
deliverables.remaining: Expand the approved document/layout/page matrix and durable processing path. Prove browser-to-live-scanner-to-OCR integration.

deliverables.name: Extraction
deliverables.existing: Source figures and reviewed domain records remain separate. Tax now supports explicit jurisdiction/type,amount meaning,amount,tax-year label and period with corrections/history. No new OCR field/layout coverage is claimed.
deliverables.remaining: Complete domain records and broader document layouts. Other asset types, arbitrary Excel and durable integration remain open. Source classification does not verify ownership or current value.

deliverables.name: Indexing

deliverables.remaining: Complete durable document/financial/knowledge indexing as applicable, replacement/rebuild/invalidation and freshness handling across required document classes.
